name: dsh-init
description: Claude Code style /init for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): interviews you, surveys the codebase, then writes a minimal AGENTS.md (plus an optional AGENTS.local.md) and migrates away a deprecated CLAUDE.md.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "import('./lib/index.js').then(m => { if (m.name !== 'dsh-init' || typeof m.apply !== 'function' || !Array.isArray(m.inject)) { console.error('plugin exports invalid'); process.exit(1); } console.log('plugin load OK:', m.name); }).catch(e => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); })"
